name: popsicle
headline: Marketing-Tech-Ads-Automation: AdWords Automation
short_description: Automation Solutions for various Google AdWords tasks such as Bids Optimizations, Reporting, Campaign Create, Budgeting etc
author: 01dkg

sections.overview:
Marketing-Tech-Ads-Automation streamlines Google AdWords operations through AI-driven tools and real-time automation. GeK(i)AI generates keywords at scale while filtering low-quality terms using historical search data and live Google AdWords validation. The skill automates bid optimization, keyword uploads for shopping and search ads, and provides dynamic reporting dashboards that fetch data directly from AdWords. It solves manual campaign management, keyword research bottlenecks, and reporting inefficiencies for marketing teams and agencies handling multiple customer accounts.
Generate and validate keywords at scale with AI-driven quality filtering
Automate bid optimization and keyword bidding strategy forecasting
Create and upload shopping and search ad campaigns in bulk
Build dynamic reporting dashboards for multi-customer AdWords accounts
